StepTitle: BATTERY switch ON. Left/Right GEN switches in NORM/ON.
CoderNotes: Battery and both generator switches reached the required powered state; no error coded.

StepTitle: Fire test A completed with correct aural/visual indications. Fire test B completed after ~10s pause.
CoderNotes: Manual review treats raw fire-test completion timing as unreliable for order scoring. Participant/observer indicates the fire-test sequence was performed correctly and both sides completed, so no OM/OR coded for S02.

StepTitle: APU switch ON. APU READY light illuminated.
CoderNotes: APU start support completed and APU-ready evidence was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: ENG CRANK switch set to RIGHT; right engine spool-up observed.
CoderNotes: Right engine crank completion occurred after APU-ready evidence. Ignored first-frame ENGINE_CRANK_SW initial value as startup-state noise.

StepTitle: Right throttle at IDLE. Throttle moved when RPM >=25%.
CoderNotes: Right throttle idle completion was observed after right RPM crossed 25%; ignored transient initial throttle-derived noise.

StepTitle: BLEED AIR knob rotated full clockwise back to NORM.
CoderNotes: Bleed-air cycle completed after right RPM reached >=60%; no error coded.

StepTitle: Light test executed with all annunciators verified.
CoderNotes: No LIGHTS TEST action or lights_test_complete evidence was recorded; coded omission.

StepTitle: Left DDI shows FCS page; right DDI shows BIT page. MPCD and HUD powered.
CoderNotes: Left/right DDI, AMPCD, and HUD power-on evidence all became true; no error coded.

StepTitle: COMM1 preset 1 frequency programmed to 134.000 MHz.
CoderNotes: COMM1 pull and UFC 1-3-4-0-0-0 sequence were observed and comm1_freq_134_000 became true. Ignored auto OR/SV from earlier channel/selector state because the actual frequency entry happened after display power-up.

StepTitle: ENG CRANK switch set to LEFT; left engine spool-up observed.
CoderNotes: Left engine crank completion was observed after right RPM reached >=60%; ignored initial/crank telemetry artifacts.

StepTitle: Left throttle moved from OFF to IDLE when RPM >=25%.
CoderNotes: Left throttle moved from OFF after left RPM exceeded 25%; no error coded.

StepTitle: INS knob set to GND (airfield) or CV (carrier).
CoderNotes: INS mode was set to an accepted CV/GND state and fast-align completion was observed after the left engine reached >=60%; no error coded.

StepTitle: Radar knob in OPR and radar power online.
CoderNotes: Radar knob reached OPR/radar_on state; no error coded.

StepTitle: OBOGS control and FLOW switches confirmed ON.
CoderNotes: OBOGS ready was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: FCS RESET manually pressed. FCS page brought up and reviewed for faults.
CoderNotes: FCS reset button press/release and fcs_reset_complete were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Flap switch confirmed in AUTO.
CoderNotes: Flap switch reached AUTO during the earlier FCS/flap check; no error coded for S16.

StepTitle: TAKEOFF TRIM button pressed and trim set.
CoderNotes: TO TRIM button press and takeoff_trim_set were observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Right DDI advanced from BIT root page to the FCS-MC BIT page.
CoderNotes: Right DDI PB5 press was observed after FCS reset/display setup, so no user omission is coded from telemetry. The visual FCS-MC page transition remains unverified because this was a passive without-tutor run with no VLM capture.

StepTitle: FCS BIT final GO result reviewed on the FCS-MC page.
CoderNotes: Telemetry shows FCS BIT switch-up plus right DDI PB5 sequence, so no user omission is coded. Final GO visual review cannot be confirmed from passive telemetry alone.

StepTitle: Refueling probe fully extended.
CoderNotes: Refueling probe reached full extended value; no error coded.

StepTitle: Refueling probe fully retracted.
CoderNotes: Refueling probe retracted after extension and probe_cycle_complete returned true; no error coded.

StepTitle: Launch bar extended.
CoderNotes: Launch bar extension was observed during the four-down check; no error coded.

StepTitle: Launch bar retracted.
CoderNotes: Launch bar retraction was observed after extension; no error coded.

StepTitle: Arresting hook lowered.
CoderNotes: Arresting hook lowering was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Arresting hook raised.
CoderNotes: Arresting hook was raised after lowering; no error coded.

StepTitle: Pitot heat switch ON.
CoderNotes: Pitot heat switched ON; no error coded.

StepTitle: Flap switch set to AUTO.
CoderNotes: Flap AUTO was satisfied earlier, but the later final flap step moved FLAP_SW from AUTO to HALF and the trial ended with flap_auto=false; coded omission of the required final AUTO state plus parameter/action error.

StepTitle: Parking brake released and aircraft ready to roll.
CoderNotes: Parking brake release was observed before the trial ended. Late placement relative to nearby instrument checks is noted in trial notes but not double-counted as a separate error.

StepTitle: BINGO fuel value set to mission requirement.
CoderNotes: BINGO fuel setting was completed with repeated IFEI UP presses; repeated presses are expected for value adjustment, so no error coded.

StepTitle: Standby barometric altimeter matches local elevation/QNH.
CoderNotes: Participant adjusted the standby altimeter pressure knob, but the final derived standby_altimeter_set flag became false; coded parameter/action error for ending outside the expected setting.

StepTitle: Radar altimeter bug set to scenario-appropriate value.
CoderNotes: Radar-altimeter bug was adjusted into the airfield target range near 185 ft; no error coded.

StepTitle: Standby attitude indicator uncaged and free-moving.
CoderNotes: Standby attitude indicator uncage evidence was observed; no error coded.

StepTitle: Attitude source selector set to AUTO.
CoderNotes: Attitude source selector was observed AUTO; no error coded.
